prompt: Implement a class `CircuitBreaker` with `CircuitBreaker(failure_threshold: int, reset_timeout: float)`. Method `call(fn, now: float)` invokes `fn()` and returns its result if the circuit is CLOSED; if `fn()` raises, increments a failure count and re-raises; after `failure_threshold` consecutive failures, the circuit OPENs and further `call()`s raise `RuntimeError('circuit open')` without calling `fn` at all, until `reset_timeout` seconds have passed since opening, at which point the next `call()` tries `fn()` again (half-open) — success closes the circuit and resets the failure count, failure re-opens it immediately.
